sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in Vee-fib. [pause 0.35] The electrical activity in the ventricles turns chaotic. [pause 0.35] Instead of squeezing, they just quiver. [pause 0.4] And with no squeeze, there's no cardiac output. [pause 0.35] No pulse. [pause 0.45] Vee-fib is a shockable rhythm. [pause 0.35] Start CPR, and defibrillate as soon as possible. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
